physical_anchor: Holds and is permitting the Pebble copper-gold-molybdenum porphyry deposit in Alaska; no mine built, permit denied by the Army Corps with ongoing litigation/appeals.
value_chain_position: Pre-permit copper-gold-moly developer — a genuine copper deposit, but the project sits well outside the taxonomy's 'permitted/FID-stage' developer bar given the permit denial and litigation overhang.
